request: Write me a report comparing the BMW M3 vs Lexus IS F

sections.title: Engines
sections.text: The E92 BMW M3 uses a 4.0-litre V8 (S65) that makes 414 hp and revs to 8,400 rpm. The Lexus IS F uses a 5.0-litre V8 (2UR-GSE) that makes 416 hp, so the two are within 2 hp of each other.

sections.title: Gearboxes
sections.text: The M3 came with a six-speed manual or a seven-speed dual-clutch (M DCT). The IS F has an eight-speed automatic only.

sections.title: Verdict
sections.text: Power is a tie. The M3, with its manual option and higher-revving engine, is the sharper car on a track; the IS F is the easier car to live with every day.
